object_description: compact four-story structure with an expressive roof and colonnade
design_condition: The compact building is centrally positioned along the school's main access axis, connects to the existing schoolhouse through a colonnade, uses the sloping terrain for the auditorium, and expands the surrounding outdoor spaces.

positive.statement: The access axis, colonnade, and new building form a coherent overall situation.

position.target: access axis, colonnade, and new building
position.rationale: South-facing frontage and connecting colonnade anchor the new building along the access edge.

positive.statement: The compact central volume allows a spacious and varied expansion of the outdoor area.

position.target: compact central volume and outdoor area
position.rationale: Compact mass leaves distributed outdoor space around its perimeter, especially beyond the north-facing edge.

positive.statement: The skeleton structure is a good prerequisite for the required flexibility of use.

position.rationale: Regular repeated structural grid is visible across the top and all elevation point patterns.

positive.statement: The compact building height and footprint result in very good compactness and economic efficiency.

position.rationale: Economic compactness is a whole-building judgment without a distinct spatial marker.

positive.statement: The sloping terrain is cleverly used to provide the auditorium with the required height.

position.rationale: Auditorium is constrained to a lower terrain-facing portion beneath the compact upper volume.

negative.statement: The interplay of lightness and heaviness creates an ultimately obscure attitude toward the massive historic school building.

position.rationale: The comment concerns the new building’s south-facing relationship toward the existing school.

negative.statement: The music booths can only be accessed through the auditorium.

position.rationale: Interior booths are not distinguishable; approximate them within the auditorium-facing building surface.

negative.statement: The separation of the special education rooms from the other classrooms is clearly disadvantageous.

position.rationale: Interior separation is unobservable, so the rooms are placed in a plausible lateral classroom zone.

negative.statement: The long paths are clearly disadvantageous, especially for students from the old school building.

position.target: long paths from old school building
position.rationale: Long circulation is anchored along the access-side connection toward the south edge.

negative.statement: The expressive roof and proposed skylights are not conclusively demonstrated.

position.rationale: Distinctive sloping roof is clearly visible in the top and elevation silhouettes; skylights remain unresolved.

negative.statement: The separation of the two teaching areas through the teacher's room is problematic.

position.target: two teaching areas and teacher's room
position.rationale: Internal teaching-area division is not visible; a lateral upper-floor zone provides the approximate anchor.
